en.title: Trump warns Iran of annihilation over dirty bomb threat as Saudi crown prince meets US commander
en.dek: President Trump vowed to wipe out Iran if a dirty bomb attack occurs on U.S. soil while Saudi Arabia's crown prince met the U.S. Central Command chief amid Houthi hostilities.
facts: President Trump renewed threat to annihilate Iran if it launches a dirty bomb on U.S. soil while in Shenzhen, China
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met US Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper in Riyadh to discuss military affairs and regional developments
Israeli officials warn about Iranian chemical and biological weapons programs
Trump weighs major strikes on Iran as Israeli officials warn about Iranian chemical and biological weapons programs
body: President Trump renewed his threat to annihilate Iran if it launches a dirty bomb on U.S. soil, stating this while in Shenzhen, China, for talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, according to The Jerusalem Post and The Hill.

Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met US Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper in Riyadh to discuss military affairs and regional developments amid escalating Houthi hostilities, according to The Jerusalem Post and The Straits Times.
Israeli officials have warned about Iranian chemical and biological weapons programs as Trump weighs major strikes on Iran, according to Axios and The Jerusalem Post.
Netanyahu pressed Trump for a four-to-seven-day Iran strike campaign, according to a report from The Jerusalem Post.
The developments reflect heightened tensions in the Iran-Israel-Houthi escalation, with multiple diplomatic and military moves occurring on November 19, 2026.
The Saudi crown prince's meeting with the U.S. Central Command chief comes amid ongoing Houthi hostilities and regional security concerns.
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's reported pressure on Trump for an Iran strike campaign underscores the strategic coordination between the two allies.
en.context: On November 19, 2026, President Trump was in Shenzhen, China, for talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin when he renewed his threat against Iran regarding a potential dirty bomb attack. Meanwhile, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper in Riyadh to discuss regional developments and military affairs amid escalating Houthi hostilities. Israeli officials simultaneously warned about Iranian chemical and biological weapons programs, with Netanyahu reportedly pressing Trump for an Iran strike campaign.

en.body: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met US Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper in Riyadh. The two discussed military affairs and regional developments. According to The Jerusalem Post and The Straits Times.

es.headline: El príncipe heredero saudí se reúne con el jefe de CENTCOM de EE. UU. ante hostilidades hutíes
es.body: El príncipe heredero saudí, Mohammed bin Salman, se reunió con el jefe del Comando Central de EE. UU., almirante Brad Cooper, en Riad. Los dos discutieron asuntos militares y desarrollos regionales. Según The Jerusalem Post y The Straits Times.

fr.headline: Le prince héritier saoudien rencontre le chef du CENTCOM américain au milieu des hostilités des Houthis
fr.body: Le prince héritier saoudien Mohammed ben Salmane a rencontré le chef du commandement central américain, l'amiral Brad Cooper, à Ryad. Les deux ont discuté d'affaires militaires et de développements régionaux. Selon Le Poste de Jérusalem et The Straits Times.

de.headline: Kronprinz von Saudi-Arabien trifft US-CENTCOM-Chef bei Huthi-Hostilitäten
de.body: Saudi-Kronprinz Mohammed bin Salman traf sich in Riad mit dem US-Zentralkommando-Chef Admiral Brad Cooper. Die beiden sprachen über Militäraffären und regionale Entwicklungen. Laut The Jerusalem Post und The Straits Times.

it.headline: Il principe ereditario saudita incontra il capo del CENTCOM USA amid ostilità degli Houthi
it.body: Il principe ereditario saudita Mohammed bin Salman ha incontrato il capo del Central Command USA, l'ammiraglio Brad Cooper, a Riad. I due hanno discusso questioni militari e sviluppi regionali. Secondo The Jerusalem Post e The Straits Times.

pt.headline: Príncipe herdeiro da Arábia Saudita reúne-se com chefe do CENTCOM dos EUA em meio a hostilidades com os hutis
pt.body: O príncipe herdeiro da Arábia Saudita, Mohammed bin Salman, reuniu-se com o chefe do Comando Central dos EUA, almirante Brad Cooper, em Riade. Os dois discutiram assuntos militares e desenvolvimentos regionais. Segundo o The Jerusalem Post e o The Straits Times.

zh.headline: 沙特王储会见美国中央司令部司令 面对胡塞武装敌对
zh.body: 沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼在利雅得会见美国中央司令部司令布拉德·库珀上将。双方讨论军事事务和地区发展。据《耶路撒冷邮报》和《海峡时报》报道。

ja.headline: サウジアラビア皇太子、フーティー勢力との対立で米中央軍司令官と面会

en.headline: Trump warns Iran of 'wiping out' if dirty bomb attack carried out
en.body: President Trump renewed threat to annihilate Iran if it launches a dirty bomb on U.S. soil. Trump said this while in Shenzhen, China, for talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. According to The Jerusalem Post and The Hill.

es.headline: Trump advierte a Irán de 'borrarlo' si hay ataque con bomba sucia
es.body: El presidente Trump renovó la amenaza de aniquilar a Irán si lanza una bomba sucia en suelo estadounidense. Trump dijo esto mientras estaba en Shenzhen, China, para conversar con Xi Jinping y Vladimir Putin. Según The Jerusalem Post y The Hill.

fr.headline: Trump menace l'Iran d'un 'effacement' en cas d'attaque à la bombe sale
fr.body: Le président Trump a renouvelé sa menace d'annihiler l'Iran s'il lançait une bombe sale sur le sol américain. Trump a déclaré cela alors qu'il était à Shenzhen, en Chine, pour des entretiens avec Xi Jinping et Vladimir Poutine. Selon Le Poste de Jérusalem et The Hill.

de.headline: Trump warnt Iran vor 'Auslöschung' bei Schmutzbomben-Anschlag
de.body: Präsident Trump erneuerte die Drohung, den Iran auszulöschen, falls dieser einen Schmutzbomben-Anschlag auf US-Boden verübt. Trump sagte dies bei seinem Aufenthalt in Shenzhen, China, bei Gesprächen mit Xi Jinping und Wladimir Putin. Laut The Jerusalem Post und The Hill.

it.headline: Trump avverte l'Iran di 'cancellarlo' se attacco con bomba sporca
it.body: Il presidente Trump ha rinnovato la minaccia di annientare l'Iran se lanciasse una bomba sporca sul suolo statunitense. Trump ha dichiarato questo mentre si trovava a Shenzhen, in Cina, per incontri con Xi Jinping e Vladimir Putin. Secondo The Jerusalem Post e The Hill.

pt.headline: Trump avisa Irão de 'apagar-se' se ataque com bomba suja for realizado
pt.body: O presidente Trump renovou a ameaça de aniquilar o Irão se este lançar uma bomba suja no solo americano. Trump disse isso enquanto estava em Shenzhen, na China, para conversas com Xi Jinping e Vladimir Putin. Segundo o The Jerusalem Post e o The Hill.

zh.headline: 特朗普警告伊朗‘将被抹除’ 如使用脏弹袭击
zh.body: 特朗普重申若伊朗在美土实施脏弹袭击将遭毁灭。特朗普在深圳会见习近平和普京期间发表上述言论。据《耶路撒冷邮报》和《山丘报》报道。

ja.headline: トランプ、汚爆弾攻撃あれば「イラン消滅」と警告
ja.body: トランプ大統領が汚爆弾が米土上で使用された場合、イランを根絶するとの脅威を再び表明。トランプはシンガポールで習近平とプーチンと会談中のシャンハイでこの発言。エルサレム・ポストとザ・ヒルによる。

ko.headline: 트럼프, 더러운 폭탄 공격 시 '소멸' 경고
ko.body: 트럼프 대통령이 미국 본토에서 더러운 폭탄 공격이 발생할 경우 이란을 소멸시킬 것이라고 위협을 재차 강조했습니다. 트럼프는 시진핑과 블라디미르 푸틴과의 회담을 위해 중국 선전시를 방문하던 중 이같이 발언했습니다. 예루살렘 포스트와 더 힐에 따르면.
